draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.85, the 196th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 19th of 20 at DE. He lasted until pick 259, well after his grade rank (196th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 sacks in 2022, 13th of 19 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Rams. 27 career games and 0 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026.
